messages.text: Fix the off-by-one day in the harbour timetable export, run its focused tests and make a separate local commit for that fix.

action.command:
set -e
gofmt -w internal/calendar/export.go internal/calendar/export_test.go
go test ./internal/calendar
git diff --check
git add internal/calendar/export.go internal/calendar/export_test.go
git commit --only internal/calendar/export.go internal/calendar/export_test.go -m 'fix: correct timetable export day'

extraInput.justification: Format and locally commit the requested tested timetable fix.
